heroDesc.zh: 以聖經書卷為主，依舊約、新約順序收錄成人主日學與個人查經教材。
heroDesc.en: Study Scripture book by book, with adult Sunday school and personal study resources arranged in Old and New Testament order.

scriptureNote.zh: 研讀頁面的中文經文連結預設新標點和合本（神版）；英文預設 NASB 2020。每日經文的繁中譯本另用當代譯本。
scriptureNote.en: Study-page Scripture links default to CUNP (Shen edition) in Chinese and NASB 2020 in English. The Chinese Verse of the Day uses the CCB Traditional translation.

oldDesc.zh: 先讀舊約總覽，再按聖經書卷順序進入已上架的逐卷研讀。
oldDesc.en: Begin with the Old Testament overview, then explore available book studies in canonical order.

newDesc.zh: 先讀新約總覽，再按聖經順序研讀新約全部 27 卷；每卷皆有逐章重點及八堂教師教案。
newDesc.en: Begin with the overview, then study all 27 New Testament books in canonical order, each with chapter studies and eight teacher lessons.

resourcesDesc.zh: 講義、參考網站與神學專題會收錄在聖經書卷之後；目前可閱讀以下舊約縱覽講義。
resourcesDesc.en: Handouts, reference sites, and theological topics follow the biblical books. These Old Testament Survey handouts are available now.

note.zh: 研讀時請閱讀完整經文，並區分經文內容、詮釋與應用。
note.en: Read the full biblical text and distinguish the text, interpretation, and application.

old-testament.bodyZh: 從地理、歷史與書卷編排掌握全景；含八堂教師教案。
old-testament.bodyEn: A whole-Bible view of geography, history, and book order, with eight teacher lessons.

old-testament.bodyZh: 50 章逐章研讀：創造、族長、約瑟與未竟的應許。
old-testament.bodyEn: All 50 chapters: creation, ancestors, Joseph, and unfinished promise.

old-testament.bodyZh: 40 章逐章研讀：拯救、立約、曠野與會幕。
old-testament.bodyEn: All 40 chapters: rescue, covenant, wilderness, and tabernacle.

old-testament.bodyZh: 27 章逐章研讀：祭物、聖潔、鄰舍與安息。
old-testament.bodyEn: All 27 chapters: offerings, holiness, neighbor, and rest.

old-testament.bodyZh: 36 章逐章研讀：曠野兩代人、領導與土地。
old-testament.bodyEn: All 36 chapters: two wilderness generations, leadership, and land.

old-testament.bodyZh: 34 章逐章研讀：記念、愛神、社會公義與選擇生命。
old-testament.bodyEn: All 34 chapters: memory, love, social justice, and choosing life.

old-testament.bodyZh: 24 章逐章研讀：過河、征戰與分地、盟約與倫理難題。
old-testament.bodyEn: All 24 chapters: crossing, conflict, allotment, covenant, and ethical questions.

old-testament.bodyZh: 21 章逐章研讀：士師循環、失序、暴力與受害者。
old-testament.bodyEn: All 21 chapters: spiraling judges, disorder, violence, and victims.

old-testament.bodyZh: 4 章逐章研讀：喪失、忠誠、拾穗、歸屬與大衛家譜。

old-testament.bodyZh: 31 章逐章研讀：哈拿、撒母耳、掃羅與大衛的王權轉折。

old-testament.bodyZh: 24 章逐章研讀：大衛之約、權力濫用、家族動亂與問責。
